area_2_second_innings_applicability.mandatory_condition: In Innings 2, for non-terminal wickets (W_rem >= 2), lambda_wkt must be capped at runs_required: lambda_wkt_eff = min(lambda_wkt, runs_required). For terminal wickets (W_rem = 1), uncapped lambda_wkt applies as innings terminates.

area_3_parameter_stability.tail_wicket_parameters_explained: IPL Z0(2) - Z0(1) = 3.0 runs vs T20I 21.0 runs reflects empirical franchise run rate parity between 8-down (5.3 RPO) and 9-down (5.7 RPO) vs steep international tail drop (7.3 to 4.7 RPO).
